distribution.narrative: Liao et al. (2022) described Scolytoplatypus wugongshanensis from Jiangxi and Fujian, including the Wugong Mountain holotype and additional type-series localities.

host_note: The holotype was collected by log dissection from an unidentified Fagaceae host; biology notes galleries in small broadleaved branches including unidentified Fagaceae. Host is retained at family level.
taxonomy_summary: The current accepted identity is Scolytoplatypus wugongshanensis Liao, Lai & Beaver, 2022.

taxonomic_history.name: Scolytoplatypus wugongshanensis
taxonomic_history.note: Current accepted name in the integrated taxonomic backbone.

nomenclature_note: Scolytoplatypus wugongshanensis Liao, Lai & Beaver was described as a new species in 2022 and maps directly to stable VSN_5450.
